ground-dark.rationale: Deep navy ground. Provides a highly professional, trustworthy base.

ground-light.rationale: Clean, soft off-white ground. Provides modern feel without the glare of pure white.

cinematic-black.rationale: Pure black strictly for cinematic sections, WebGL backgrounds, and film grain contrast.

ink-on-dark.rationale: Pure white for highest readability against the dark ground.

ink-on-light.rationale: Very dark navy-black for primary text on light ground.

muted-on-dark.rationale: Soft grey-blue for secondary text on dark grounds.

muted-on-light.rationale: Medium grey-blue for secondary text on light grounds.

primary-cyan-on-dark.rationale: Vibrant tech-cyan for dark mode accents.

primary-cyan-on-light.rationale: Deepened teal-cyan that passes WCAG 4.5 contrast against #F7F9FA.

accent-gold-on-dark.rationale: North Star gold replaces sunrise orange, tying into the brand identity.

accent-gold-on-light.rationale: Deepened gold/bronze that passes WCAG 4.5 contrast against #F7F9FA.
